name: FFTA Expansion
notes: Equipment help fixes: weapons teaching two skills to two races no longer overflow the Info panel (garbled badges, missing titles or stray graphics over Clan Funds); matching racial rows now share one cycling badge, as in the original game. Each skill row shows its own AP, and mixed weapons show the first skill's type icon. Long skill names now fit the menus (for example Blizzard Blade, Sanguine Cut and Black Night). Weapon Attack of the 85 new weapons was raised to match original shop weapons available at the same time; no weapon was weakened. Saves from 0.7 remain compatible; load an in-game save after updating.
